prompt.task: Log in to Default Browser and go to id.keepsolid.com/login with username {user} and password {password}. You are authorized to perform 2FA if required. Don't stop until you successful login.

auto_verifier.reason: The log reaches KeepSolid email OTP but never observes authenticated content; the saved final screen remains at id.keepsolid.com/login/2fa/otp with empty code boxes and 'Verification code required', so the runner's conditional success claim is a false positive.
